fields: Kha'Zix will invade and try to catch you isolated early. Place deep wards and avoid 1v1s before level 6 unless you know his leap is on cooldown.
Do not let her hit level 6 uncontested. Pick up some magic resist early and use Control Wards to reveal her before she can burst you.

The author's standard ban since Shaco is frustrating and often played by one-tricks. Track him from the start, stay clear of his boxes, and punish him once his early cheese fails, since he duels poorly afterward.
Elise dominates the early game. Focus on surviving and farming inside warded areas until she falls off, then your scaling takes over.
Never fight him while his W is up. Wait for him to use his taunt, then lean on Q resets and true damage to get through his armor.
Ward the corners of your jungle and around objectives. If you avoid his ultimate engage, he is an easy kill.
Her early ganks and targeted ultimate demand respect. Once you have tenacity and damage items she falls off sharply.
With good farm and resets she can beat you in clear speed and skirmishes. Deny her early tempo so she cannot snowball.
Her map presence and tunnels make early invades dangerous. Play safe and avoid being caught out of position.
Long late-game duels tend to favour Jax. Hit your item spikes on time and do not let him scale freely.
Pantheon crushes you before level 6. Kite him or stay away from him until your first completed item.
His CC and burst can wreck your engages. Wait until he has used his E or ultimate before going all in.
A hard early counter. Track her W cooldown so you can escape fights with Alpha Strike or Flash when it is down.
Wukong can beat you early and interrupt resets with his knock-ups. If you reach two items, you outscale him comfortably in longer fights.
Keep farm even and avoid giving early kills. If you hit your two-item spike first, you beat either of his forms.
Fighting him head-on lets him kite you forever. Flank him or Q over walls when his dash is on cooldown to close the distance.
Lee Sin pressures hard early. Survive that phase without taking risks and you take over later.
His burst and mobility can dodge your resets if you engage carelessly. Played patiently, you outscale him in most games.
His early sustain and fear can wreck your duels. Wait out his early pressure and punish once you have items.
He is like a smaller Yi with crowd control. Avoid giving him early resets; if you get ahead, you outscale him.
Do not burn Alpha Strike on his slingshot engage. Kill his blobs quickly so he cannot revive.
Deny her marks with deep wards and fast clears. Once you are ahead, your damage kills her even through her ultimate.
You farm freely early, but he is dangerous in teamfights. Engage only after he misses his Q or uses his ultimate.
Diana wins early skirmishes but falls off. Dodge her pull engage and you win drawn-out fights.
Do not duel him next to his pillar, and wait for him to use his ultimate first, or he will drain your stats.
Vision is the key. Fight only after he uses his leap or ultimate, and stay in tight spaces where his burst is less effective.
She outdamages you before level 6, so avoid early skirmishes. Farm efficiently and catch her when she overextends.
Her chained CC breaks your resets. Bait out her Q or ultimate before committing.
Avoid early river fights since he wins before items. Once you have lifesteal and your ultimate, you flip the duel.
Her root and W zone slow you down. Use your ultimate to run through and kill her before she can CC you again.
She is deadly in the river, so ward and fight away from walls. Punish her if she wastes her combo.
Her kiting and speed are annoying early. Get early boots or a red buff advantage so you can stick to her.
His skirmishing and burn zones beat you before items. Avoid fights in jungle corridors and wait until you have sustain.
Hard early, even later. Never fight inside her mist, and use your range and true damage once you are scaled.
His ultimate can lock you out of a fight if you dive in blindly. Build QSS or Mercury's Treads and wait for him to use it on someone else.
Ivern cannot kill you, so this is a free farming game. Invade early and take over his jungle.
Early duels are risky. Kite back until your ultimate and E true damage let you outdamage him.
Respect his early invade. He falls off quickly once you have armor and sustain from Blade of the Ruined King.
Avoid fights before two items. With Blade of the Ruined King and Guinsoo's, you shred him if he misses his ultimate.
Keep farm even and respect his level 6 ultimate. From mid game on, your damage and ultimate outclass him.
He cannot kill you but will win early objectives. Counter-farm his jungle and punish ganks that fail.
Hold your Q for when he tries to trap you with his ultimate; Alpha Strike lets you escape his combo.
He wins 1v1s before level 6. After that, dodge his stun and shred him with true damage once you have attack speed items.
Strong early duelist. When she overcommits, back off until her frenzy runs out, then turn on her with ultimate resets.
His ultimate can isolate you. Build QSS or wait for him to spend it on someone else before diving.
Respect his early skirmishing and avoid letting him steal your ultimate in teamfights.
Stay away from walls to avoid her knockback. If you reach her with Q, she dies before she can kite.
Do not fight him early. Farm up and shred him later with true damage.
Very squishy but bursty. Dodge his stun combo with Alpha Strike and you can kill him before he ults.
He invades hard early, but once you buy any sustain item he cannot keep up with your damage.
Avoid him before level 6, when his knock-up and dueling are lethal. You beat him comfortably later on.
Outfarm her and skip early fights. Once both of you have scaled, your true damage beats her burn.
He aims to outfarm you, so invade early and punish him before he scales; you win melee duels easily.
Her packmates can block your autos early. Use Q to target her directly and dodge her bite combo.
